'Fear not the bitterness, for it will keep you awake and alive.'
fork:
A strong tea that once saved lives in the deserts of Sargon.
"Do not fear the bitterness. It will keep you lucid, lucid enough to stay alive."

zh: “她总是想为你多省一点。”
official: 'She's always looking out for ways to save you a coin or two.'
fork: "She always wants to save a little more for you."

zh: “我已到达接头地点。”
official: 'I've arrived at the rendezvous point.'
fork: "I have reached the rendezvous point."

zh: “看到你的钱包，她总是很开心。”
official: 'She's always happy whenever you pull out your wallet.'
fork: "She is always happy whenever she sees your wallet."

zh: 一套彰显家族成员身份的正式着装。 “在这里，服装有言语不能说明的意义。”
official: A set of formalwear to showcase one's membership in a famiglia. 'Here, there are things that clothes can say and words cannot.'
fork: A formal outfit that marks its wearer as a member of a family. "Here, clothes carry meanings that words cannot express."

zh:
一个属于精准之人的狙击镜。
“定住身形，盯紧目标，钉死敌人。”
official:
A scope for those who always hit their marks.
'Pick your target, get them in your sights, then shoot them dead.'
fork:
A sniper scope for those who live by Precision.
"Hold your stance, lock onto the target, nail the enemy down."

zh: “除了有定位与穿透效用，也可作为诱饵使用。”
official: 'Aside from sighting and penetration, it can also be used as bait.'
fork: "Besides locating and piercing, it can also serve as a decoy."

zh:
一把曾在炎国的江湖上铲除不义的短刀。
“拔刀之前，先想清楚是否值得。拔出刀后，就不可再犹豫。”
official:
A dagger that used to purge injustice in the jianghu of Yan.
'Think carefully before you draw your blade. Once you've done so, there's no time to hesitate.'
fork:
A dagger that once struck down injustice in the jianghu of Yan.
"Before you draw your blade, think carefully about whether it is worth it. Once it is drawn, hesitate no more."

zh:
一份属于迅捷之人的作战粮。
“它的作用是提供能量，不是满足口腹之欲。”
official:
A combat ration for those always on the go.
'It's here to supply energy, not satisfy a gourmet.'
fork:
Combat rations for the Swift.
"Their purpose is to supply energy, not to satisfy the appetite."

zh: “锅炉工先生经常看着这个头盔发呆，他在想什么呢？”
official: 'The guy working the boilers stares at this helmet a lot. What's he thinking about?'
fork: "Mr. Boilerman often stares blankly at this helmet. What could he be thinking about?"

zh:
一把曾在阿戈尔的漩涡里击碎浪涛的重刃。
“直面那些你必将战胜的目标，证明你比它们更强大。”
official:
A heavy blade that once broke the waves of a whirlpool in Ægir.
'Face the enemies you must prevail over, and prove your superior strength.'
fork:
A heavy blade that once shattered the waves in the whirlpools of Ægir.
"Face the targets you are bound to defeat, and prove that you are stronger than they are."

zh: “赶紧把术师们派到战场上去！”
official: 'Get the Casters onto the field this instant!'
fork: "Hurry up and send the Casters out onto the battlefield!"

zh:
一柄曾在维多利亚的工厂内铸造和平的重锤，如今它的质地更硬。
“用同样的铁与火，去终结那场战争。”
official:
A hammer that once forged peace in Victoria's factories, now harder than ever.
'Now, use this very iron and fire to end that war.'
fork:
A heavy hammer that once forged peace in the factories of Victoria. Now its metal is harder still.
"With the same iron and fire, put an end to that war."

zh:
一柄曾在维多利亚的工厂内铸造和平的重锤，如今它的势头更猛。
“用同样的铁与火，去终结那场战争。”
official:
A hammer that once forged peace in Victoria's factories, now stronger than ever.
'Now, use this very iron and fire to end that war.'
fork:
A heavy hammer that once forged peace in the factories of Victoria. Now it strikes with even greater momentum.
"With the same iron and fire, put an end to that war."

zh:
一枚属于突袭之人的手雷。
“就是现在！！！”
official:
A grenade for those who carry out raids.
'The time is now!!!'
fork:
A grenade for those who live for the Raid.
"Now!!!"

zh: 一款卡西米尔各大周边商城在售的储蓄罐。 “将你积攒起的幸运传递给喜爱的选手吧。”
official: A savings jar carried by every major merch retailer in Kazimierz. 'Pass your saved-up fortune onto your favorite competitors.'
fork: A piggy bank sold in the major merchandise shops across Kazimierz. "Pass the luck you have saved up on to your favorite contestant."

zh: “呼叫调度中心，呼叫调度中心，我们已准备好接收指令。”
official: 'Calling Dispatch Center, calling Dispatch Center, we're ready for instructions.'
fork: "Calling the Dispatch Center, calling the Dispatch Center. We are ready to receive orders."

zh: “你们去救伤员，我来对付这些混蛋！”
official: 'You go save the wounded, I'll handle these bastards!'
fork: "You go and save the wounded. I'll deal with these bastards!"

zh: “通过触摸有限的极致，我们得以观察无限的边缘。”
official: 'By reaching the peak of the finite, we can see the edge of the infinite.'
fork: "By touching the limit of the finite, we come to observe the edge of the infinite."

zh: “我会让你们记住这份教训，我将让你们永远对暗处怀有恐惧。”
official: 'I'll teach all of you a lesson you'll never forget, and instill an eternal fear of the darkness.'
fork: "I will make you remember this lesson. I will make you fear the dark forever."

zh: “我会保护好我的队友，我会保护好我自己。”
official: 'I will protect my team. I will protect myself.'
fork: "I will protect my teammates. I will protect myself."

zh: “别把袋子戳破了，你不会想和这些小家伙亲密接触的。”
official: 'Don't let the bag tear. You don't want to get up close and personal with these guys.'
fork: "Don't puncture the bag. You really don't want to get up close and personal with these little guys."

zh: 一面代表卡西米尔骑士竞技的旗帜。 “看见它仿佛就能听到山呼海啸般的助威声。”
official: A banner for the Kazimierz Major. 'You can almost hear the whistling roar of the cheers when you look at it.'
fork: A banner that stands for the knight competitions of Kazimierz. "Just seeing it, you can almost hear the thunderous cheering of the crowd."

zh:
一个曾在拉特兰的夜空里引发大爆炸的桥夹。
“开火，别停下！克里夫，我们三个一定能闯出比这更辉煌的事业！”
official:
A clip that once caused a massive explosion over the night skies in Laterano.
'Open fire, and don't stop! Cliff, the three of us will definitely achieve greater glory than this!'
fork:
A clip that once set off a great explosion in the night sky of Laterano.
"Open fire, and don't stop! Cliff, the three of us will surely carve out a career more glorious than this!"

zh:
一柄曾在维多利亚的工厂内铸造和平的重锤，如今它的火焰更旺。
“用同样的铁与火，去终结那场战争。”
official:
A hammer that once forged peace in Victoria's factories, now burning even brighter.
'Now, use this very iron and fire to end that war.'
fork:
A heavy hammer that once forged peace in the factories of Victoria. Now its flames burn even higher.
"With the same iron and fire, put an end to that war."

zh: “增强了烈性的配方，能让你保持清醒，前提是你能忍受那种奇特的味道。”
official: 'This enhanced formula will keep you awake, if you can tolerate the unusual smell.'
fork: "A fortified, more potent formula. It will keep you alert, provided you can stand the peculiar smell."

zh: “你可以用它来挡住一些攻击，它并不介意。”
official: 'You can use it to block some attacks, it won't mind.'
fork: "You can use it to block some attacks. It doesn't mind."

zh: “她听懂了你说的那句谢谢，她很高兴能救下你。”
official: 'She understood your gratitude, and is happy to have saved you.'
fork: "She understood the 'thank you' you said, and she is glad she could save you."

zh: “它能让目标痛到打滚，使用前一定要确认好风向。”
official: 'It can make the target fall to the ground crying, so make sure the wind's not blowing in your face before use.'
fork: "It will have its target rolling in agony. Always check the wind direction before using it."

zh:
"一块曾在谢拉格的山峰上见证日月升落的不融冰。
“让自己冷静下来，如同冰川，不可被撼动，却能摧毁一切。”"
official:
A piece of never-melting ice from Kjerag's snowy peaks that has witnessed the rising and setting of the sun for ages.
'Calm yourself down, be like a glacier: movable by none, yet able to destroy all.'
fork:
"A piece of unmelting ice that once watched the sun and moon rise and set on the peaks of Kjerag.
'Calm yourself, like a glacier: unshakable, yet able to destroy everything.'"

zh: “是的，这台设备能帮上你不小的忙，但要获得胜利，还是得靠你自己。”
official: 'Sure, this equipment can help you with a lot of stuff, but if you seek victory, you need to rely on yourself.'
fork: "Yes, this device can be a great help to you, but to win, you still have to rely on yourself."

zh: “这是一份礼物，你可以让它变成任何你想要的样子。”
official: 'This is a gift you can turn into anything you want.'
fork: "This is a gift. You can make it into anything you want it to be."

zh: “仔细听，博士正在布置任务。”
official: 'Listen up, the Doctor's starting the mission briefing.'
fork: "Listen closely, the Doctor is assigning tasks."

zh: “端起酒杯，注意微笑的弧度，我保证你会火得一塌糊涂！不，现在还不够打动人，再去换一套衣服看看。”
official: 'Raise your glass, watch your smile, and I guarantee you'll go viral! No, that won't get enough eyes on you, go try on another outfit.'
fork: "Raise your glass and mind the curve of your smile. I guarantee you'll be a smash hit! No, that's still not impressive enough. Go change into another outfit."

official: 'The price...'
fork: "The price…"

zh: “见证过无数勇士与英豪的诞生。”
official: 'Witness to the births of countless warriors and heroes.'
fork: "Has witnessed the birth of countless warriors and heroes."

zh: “造就了无数血肉与精神的溃散。”
official: 'Contributor to countless routs, both physical and mental.'
fork: "Has shattered countless bodies and spirits."

zh: “拉特兰人从不曾怀疑过铳骑的威严。”
official: 'Laterans have never doubted the gun-knights' might.'
fork: "The people of Laterano have never doubted the majesty of the Gun-Knight."

zh: “炎国人相信那些关于天师的上古传说绝非完全出自虚构。”
official: 'The Yanese people believe the ancient Tianshi legends are by no means complete fiction.'
fork: "The people of Yan believe the ancient legends of the Tianshi are not entirely fiction."

zh: “属于阿戈尔人的秘密被埋葬在最深的海沟中，但它从未真正死去。”
official: 'The Ægirians' secrets are buried in the deepest ocean trenches, but they have never truly died.'
fork: "A secret of the Ægir lies buried in the deepest trench, but it has never truly died."

zh: “维多利亚人用数个时代证明了蒸汽与齿轮中蕴藏着真理。”
official: 'The Victorians have proven throughout the ages that truth hides within steam and gears.'
fork: "Over several eras, the people of Victoria have proven that truth lies within steam and gears."

zh: “谢拉格人相信冰川最深处的宝石是耶拉冈德的眼泪。”
official: 'The Kjerags believe the gemstones hidden in the depths of glaciers are Kjeragandr's tears.'
fork: "The people of Kjerag believe the gem at the deepest heart of the glacier is Kjeragandr's tear."

zh: “传说萨尔贡人将会在黄沙尽头找到时间回流的刻印。”
official: 'Legends say the Sargonians will find a mark of time going backwards at the ends of the sands.'
fork: "Legend says the people of Sargon will find the sigil of time flowing back at the far end of the golden sands."

zh: “新来的这家伙肯定能帮上忙，不是吗？”
official: 'This newbie's definitely going to help us out, right?'
fork: "This newcomer is sure to be a help, isn't he?"

zh: “变形者集群，我们早已见识到了你都能做到些什么……”
official: 'Damazti Cluster, we've long since witnessed your capabilities...'
fork: "Shapeshifter Cluster, we have already seen what you are capable of…"

zh: 一份为卡西米尔的骑士定下的戒律。 “诚实、坚定、勇敢、不屈。”
official: A list of commandments set by a Kazimierzian knight. 'Honesty. Dedication. Valor. Tenacity.'
fork: A code laid down for the knights of Kazimierz. "Honest, steadfast, brave, unyielding."

zh: 一枚能让人成为“家族成员”的叙拉古徽章。 “学会陪伴你的家人，真正的，家人。”
official: A Siracusan insignia that makes one a mafioso. 'Learn to follow your famiglia... your true famiglia.'
fork: A Siracusa crest that makes one a "family member". "Learn to stand by your family. Real family."

official: Alliance Chill Gust
fork: Alliance Cold Wind
